Presentation.LongFormTitle: Domiciliation, mail handling and substance obligations

LongFormSections.Title: Who it is for
Body: Swiss companies, entrepreneurs and foreign groups needing a registered office in Geneva with reliable administrative follow-up.
Domiciliation must remain consistent with real activity, governance and substance obligations.

LongFormSections.Title: What we provide
Body: Registered office address, mail reception and follow-up, administrative coordination, important reminders and connection with other fiduciary services.
When needed, we coordinate incorporation, accounting, tax or registers connected to the domiciled company.

LongFormSections.Title: Process
Body: We verify identity, structure, activity, beneficial owners and mail-handling needs before confirming the engagement framework.
Follow-up uses simple rules: who receives what, by when, and how decisions are documented.

LongFormSections.Title: Limitations
Body: Domiciliation does not replace an operating presence when the situation requires economic substance.
Costs depend on mail volume, administrative requests, structure complexity and associated services.
